item.title: WhatsApp Security Flaw Lets Attackers Delete Files and Leak Chat Database Information on Android Devices
item.description: WhatsApp’s November 2026 security update addresses a SQL injection flaw that could let attackers delete locally stored WhatsApp files and infer limited information about a recipient’s chat database on Android. Tracked as CVE-2026-102769, the flaw affects WhatsApp for Android versions before 2.26.35.
